tables.name: value_list
tables.grain: one allowed value of one fixed list
tables.description: Every value a controlled column may hold, with its meaning. data_dictionary.value_list names the list a column takes its values from.

columns.name: list_name
columns.description: name of the list, e.g. charge_type

columns.name: value
columns.description: the value as stored

columns.name: definition
columns.description: what the value means

tables.name: data_dictionary
tables.description: Every column of every table: its type, whether it is required, the fixed list or unit it takes, and its meaning.

columns.name: table_name
columns.description: table

columns.name: column_name
columns.description: column

columns.name: ordinal
columns.description: position of the column in the table (1 = first)

columns.name: data_type
columns.description: text, integer, numeric, date (YYYY-MM-DD), time (HH:MM) or boolean (0/1)

columns.name: required
columns.description: 1 when the column may not be NULL

columns.name: is_primary_key
columns.description: 1 when the column is part of the table's primary key

columns.name: references_table
columns.description: table the column refers to (foreign key)

columns.name: value_list

columns.name: unit
columns.description: unit of a numeric column

columns.name: definition
columns.description: what the column holds

tables.name: unit
tables.description: Every unit a rate may be stored in, what it prices per, and how to reach its standard unit: value_std = value x multiplier, or divide by the days of the billed month or year (calendar_factor) for a price per month or year. A unit whose billing period no held document states has neither.

columns.name: unit
columns.description: the unit as stored, e.g. c/kW/month

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: what one unit of the price is charged per

columns.name: billing_period
columns.description: the period the price is charged per; NULL for an energy price

columns.name: unit_std
columns.description: the standard unit value_std is in: cents per day, per kWh or per kVAh

columns.name: multiplier
columns.description: value_std = value x multiplier; NULL when the calendar decides it

columns.name: calendar_factor
columns.description: how a price per month or year becomes a price per day

columns.name: definition
columns.description: what the unit means

tables.name: distributor

columns.name: name

tables.name: source_document

columns.name: distributor_id

columns.name: pricing_year

columns.name: publisher
columns.description: who published the prices

columns.name: document_type

columns.name: hosted_by_aer

columns.name: version_label

columns.name: version_seq

columns.name: price_status

columns.name: published_on

columns.name: source_url

columns.name: local_path

columns.name: sha256
columns.description: SHA-256 of the file used

tables.name: tariff
tables.grain: one tariff code of one distributor for one period (a pricing year, or part of one after a mid-year change)
tables.source: built by scripts/tariffdb/build.py from the parsed price lists (out/aer_long.csv, out/dnsp/*.csv, out/history/*.csv)
tables.description: A network tariff code in effect for a period, with its name and customer class as published and whether its rates are provisional (AER) or final (the distributor's own list). A tariff with no rate rows is one its document lists with every price zero.
checks: customer_class IS NULL OR customer_class_published IS NOT NULL

columns.name: distributor_id
columns.description: distributor

columns.name: tariff_code
columns.description: tariff code as the source document prints it

columns.name: effective_from
columns.description: first day the tariff applies

columns.name: effective_to
columns.description: last day the tariff applies (inclusive)

columns.name: tariff_name
columns.description: name as published

columns.name: customer_class
columns.description: the customer class the published heading names; NULL when it names none

columns.name: customer_class_published
columns.description: tariff class or customer class heading as published

columns.name: pricing_basis
columns.description: how the prices apply: trial or site_specific when the published heading says so, else published; NULL for a tariff with no rates

columns.name: status
columns.description: provisional = rates from the AER's report or a proposal; final = rates from the distributor's own published price list, or the schedule a state regulator published

columns.name: document_id
columns.description: document the tariff and its rates are read from

tables.name: tariff_assignment
tables.grain: one quoted statement of how customers come to be on one tariff, for one period
tables.source: data/tariffdb/curated/*.yaml (eligibility facts with rule_type assignment), quoted from the distributor's documents
tables.description: Whether a tariff is the default, opt-in, opt-out, mandatory or assigned by the distributor, and for whom the statement says so. A tariff may be the default for one group and opt-in for another; every published statement is kept.

columns.name: distributor_id
columns.description: distributor

columns.name: tariff_code
columns.description: tariff code

columns.name: effective_from

columns.name: assignment_no
columns.description: statement number within the tariff period (1 = first)

columns.name: assignment
columns.description: how customers come to be on the tariff

columns.name: applies_to
columns.description: the customers the statement names; NULL = it names no group

columns.name: document_id
columns.description: source document version

columns.name: locator
columns.description: where in the document: xlsx:<sheet>!<cell>, pdf:p<page> or pdf-ocr:p<page> (grammar in scripts/tariffdb/locators.py)

columns.name: quote
columns.description: verbatim wording at the locator

tables.name: rate
tables.grain: one price of one tariff for one period: charge type x TOU period x season x block
tables.source: built by scripts/tariffdb/build.py from the parsed price lists (total network price, GST exclusive) and, for block bounds and stated units, data/tariffdb/curated/*.yaml
tables.description: The network price charged for one component of a tariff: the total network price (no DUoS/TUoS/jurisdictional breakdown), GST exclusive, in a unit of the unit table next to the value as published.
checks: block_from IS NULL OR block_to IS NULL OR block_from < block_to
condition IS NULL OR condition GLOB 'opt_in:[a-z0-9]*' OR condition GLOB 'meter_type:[a-z0-9]*' OR condition GLOB 'meter_class:[a-z0-9]*'

columns.name: rate_id
columns.description: <distributor_id>:<tariff_code>:<effective_from>:<charge_type>:<component>[:<tou_period>][:<season>][:<block>][:<region>]

columns.name: distributor_id
columns.description: distributor

columns.name: tariff_code
columns.description: tariff code

columns.name: effective_from
columns.description: first day the price applies

columns.name: effective_to
columns.description: last day the price applies (inclusive)

columns.name: charge_type
columns.description: daily = fixed charge per day; usage = per kWh or kVAh; demand / capacity = per kW or kVA; export = per exported kWh or kW (negative = a reward paid); metering = metering charge; other

columns.name: tou_period
columns.description: time-of-use period the price applies in (anytime = all times); NULL for daily and metering charges

columns.name: season
columns.description: season the price applies in; NULL = all year

columns.name: block
columns.description: consumption block number (1 = first) of a stepped price; NULL otherwise

columns.name: block_from
columns.description: lower bound of the block, from the curated block ladder

columns.name: block_to
columns.description: upper bound of the block; NULL = unbounded or not stated

columns.name: block_unit
columns.description: unit and reset period of the bounds

columns.name: region
columns.description: pricing zone, when the document prices one code by zone

columns.name: register
columns.description: meter register the quantity is measured on: general = general-supply import, controlled_load = a separately metered controlled-load circuit, export = energy sent out; NULL for daily, metering and other charges

columns.name: condition
columns.description: NULL = always charged; opt_in:<name> = only for a customer who opts in to <name>; meter_type:<type> = only at a site with that meter; meter_class:<class> = only at a site in that class of the distributor's metering schedule; a|b = either (curated, quoted in data/tariffdb/curated/*.yaml)

columns.name: value
columns.description: price in the rate's unit

columns.name: unit
columns.description: unit of value (the unit table says what it prices per and how to reach its standard unit)

columns.name: value_published
columns.description: number exactly as printed

columns.name: unit_published
columns.description: unit exactly as printed

columns.name: component
columns.description: component label as printed

columns.name: status
columns.description: provisional or final (the tariff's status)

columns.name: document_id
columns.description: source document version

columns.name: locator
columns.description: where in the document: xlsx:<sheet>!<cell>, pdf:p<page> or pdf-ocr:p<page> (grammar in scripts/tariffdb/locators.py)

columns.name: note

tables.name: eligibility
tables.grain: one stated criterion of one tariff for one period
tables.source: data/tariffdb/curated/*.yaml (eligibility), quoted from the distributor's documents
tables.description: Who can be on the tariff: customer type, voltage, consumption or demand thresholds, meter type, availability, required technology. How customers are assigned is tariff_assignment.
checks: value_num IS NOT NULL OR value_text IS NOT NULL OR target_tariff_code IS NOT NULL

criterion != 'customer_type' OR value_text IS NULL OR value_text IN ('residential', 'small_business', 'medium_business', 'large_business', 'business', 'unmetered', 'public_lighting', 'embedded_generation', 'controlled_load', 'storage', 'ev_charging', 'any')
criterion != 'voltage_level' OR value_text IS NULL OR value_text IN ('LV', 'HV', 'subtransmission', 'transmission', 'zone_substation')
criterion != 'meter_type' OR value_text IS NULL OR value_text IN ('interval', 'smart', 'basic', 'accumulation', 'unmetered', 'any')
criterion != 'availability' OR value_text IS NULL OR value_text IN ('open', 'closed_to_new', 'withdrawn', 'obsolete', 'trial', 'grandfathered', 'transitional')

criterion != 'requires_technology' OR value_text IS NULL OR value_text IN ('solar', 'battery', 'ev', 'controlled_load_device', 'dedicated_circuit', 'export_capable', 'storage', 'flexible_load', 'heat_pump')
